newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. 17,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,500 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 67.00 on Friday.
Today's packer bids are 66.00 with asking prices 68.00-69.00.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: 100 Year Ago: 3,200
Wk to Date: 17,600 Week Ago: 19,700 Year Ago: 28,100
